# Diana

[Improvement Society](../codex/factions.md#improvement-society)

- **Age:** eighteen (since v2)  <sub>[v2 XXIX Poetry and Prose P24](../source/v02-c29.md#nw-v02-c29-p0024), [v3 ch.Change P17](../source/v03-c01.md#nw-v03-c01-p0017)</sub>  
  _previously: 13 (v1)_  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XXVI. The Story Club Is Formed P4](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0004)</sub>
- **Status:** alive  _(assumed)_
- **Family:** [Aunt Josephine](../character/aunt-josephine.md) (relative), [Miss Barry](../character/miss-barry.md) (relative), [Fred Wright](../character/fred-wright.md) (spouse)

## Appearance

Diana is a very pretty girl with black eyes, rosy or crimson cheeks, and a black head of hair featuring glossy curls and jet-black tresses. She is described as slightly plump with the dearest dimples.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER VIII. Anne’s Bringing-up Is Begun P40](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0040), [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P22](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0022), [v1 CHAPTER XVII. A New Interest in Life P10](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0010), [v1 CHAPTER XXXIII. The Hotel Concert P12](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0012), [v2 XVII A Chapter of Accidents P5](../source/v02-c17.md#nw-v02-c17-p0005), [v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P39](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0039)_

## Personality

Diana is a practical, smart, and good-natured individual who possesses a notable talent for culinary tasks, such as making lettuce salad. Highly regarded by others, she has a recognized reputation for her taste in dressing and advice on fashion, while remaining unselfishly admiring of the gifts and graces of her friends.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER VIII. Anne’s Bringing-up Is Begun P40](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0040), [v1 CHAPTER XXXIII. The Hotel Concert P9](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0009), [v2 VI All Sorts and Conditions of Men . . . and women P2](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0002), [v2 XVI The Substance of Things Hoped For P25](../source/v02-c16.md#nw-v02-c16-p0025), [v3 ch.Atonement” P59](../source/v03-c12.md#nw-v03-c12-p0059)_

## History

Named at birth by a schoolmaster who was boarding at her home, Diana grew up alongside [Anne](../character/anne.md), with whom she swore an oath of friendship, helped establish a schoolgirl story club, named local landmarks like Lover's Lane, and imagined ghosts in the [Haunted Wood](../codex/places.md#haunted-wood). She took a trip to [Carmody](../codex/places.md#carmody) where her aunt taught her a fancy new crochet stitch. When [Anne](../character/anne.md) accidentally served her currant wine instead of raspberry cordial, Diana became dizzy and ill, leading her mother to forbid them from playing together until [Anne](../character/anne.md) later saved Diana's sister [Minnie May](../character/minnie-may.md) from croup. Diana later received a pair of kid slippers from her [Aunt Josephine](../character/aunt-josephine.md), which she gave to [Anne](../character/anne.md) on [Christmas](../codex/places.md#merry-christmas) morning before they both performed in a school concert. She accompanied [Anne](../character/anne.md) to [Charlottetown](../codex/places.md#charlottetown) for the [Exhibition](../codex/places.md#exhibition), staying at her Aunt Josephine's [Beechwood](../codex/places.md#beechwood) estate, and later rushed to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) to break the news that [Anne](../character/anne.md) had tied for first place on the [Island](../codex/places.md#island) on the Queen's [Entrance](../codex/places.md#entrance) exams. After walking down the aisle to marry [Fred Wright](../character/fred-wright.md) at [Orchard Slope](../codex/places.md#orchard-slope), Diana gave birth to a baby boy, whom [Anne](../character/anne.md) visited upon returning home from college.

## Quotes

> “Yes,” said Diana, tossing her head, “but I’m sure he doesn’t like Julia Bell so very much. I’ve heard him say he studied the multiplication table by her freckles.”
>
> — Diana — [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P19](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0019)

> “Those Pye girls are cheats all round,” said Diana indignantly, as they climbed the fence of the main road. “Gertie Pye actually went and put her milk bottle in my place in the brook yesterday. Did you ever? I don’t speak to her now.”
>
> — Diana — [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P26](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0026)

> "Why, he makes fun of all the girls. He laughs at mine because it’s so black. He’s called me a crow a dozen times; and I never heard him apologize for anything before, either."
>
> — Diana — [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P53](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0053)

> "I do think you’re mean. What shall I do? Mr. Phillips will make me sit with that horrid Gertie Pye—I know he will because she is sitting alone. Do come back, Anne."
>
> — Diana — [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P74](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0074)

> “The nicest I ever drank,” said Diana. “It’s ever so much nicer than Mrs. Lynde’s, although she brags of hers so much. It doesn’t taste a bit like hers.”
>
> — Diana — [v1 CHAPTER XVI. Diana Is Invited to Tea with Tragic Results P26](../source/v01-c16.md#nw-v01-c16-p0026)

## Relationships

### [Anne](../character/anne.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne--diana.md)

Diana and [Anne](../character/anne.md) are close, devoted best friends who spent their school years sharing secrets, games, and intense sentimental moments. Their bond faced an early strain when Diana accidentally drank homemade currant wine at Anne's house, leading Mrs. [Barry](../character/barry.md) to temporarily banish [Anne](../character/anne.md) from Diana's company until [Anne](../character/anne.md) saved Diana's sister from croup. Throughout their childhood, they maintained a deep mutual loyalty, often swearing eternal devotion and comforting each other through life's small dramas.

- Friend of — close and affectionate friends  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER VIII. Anne’s Bringing-up Is Begun P58](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0058), [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P13](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0013), [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P93](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0093), +47 more</sub>

### [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne-shirley--diana.md)

[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) is Diana's dearest chum and constant companion throughout their school years in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea). The two share an affectionate bond, engaging in imaginative play, taking walks, and comforting each other through early childhood misunderstandings and separations. Diana is always eager to celebrate Anne's successes, such as bringing her the news when [Anne](../character/anne.md) tied for first place on the Queen's examination.

- Friend of — best chums and schoolmates  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XII. A Solemn Vow and Promise P35](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0035), [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P3](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0003), [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P13](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0013), +14 more</sub>

### [Aunt Josephine](../character/aunt-josephine.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/aunt-josephine--diana.md)

[Aunt Josephine](../character/aunt-josephine.md) is Diana's great-aunt, an elder relation whom Diana visits in [Charlottetown](../codex/places.md#charlottetown). Their relationship ran into severe drama when Diana and [Anne](../character/anne.md) accidentally leaped onto her in a spare-room bed during a game, leaving the old lady furious and threatening Diana's music lessons. The situation was mended when [Anne](../character/anne.md) personally apologized, and [Aunt Josephine](../character/aunt-josephine.md) later showed warmth toward the girls, including inviting Diana and [Anne](../character/anne.md) to stay at her estate for the [Charlottetown](../codex/places.md#charlottetown) [Exhibition](../codex/places.md#exhibition).

- Relative of — aunt  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XXV. Matthew Insists on Puffed Sleeves P42](../source/v01-c25.md#nw-v01-c25-p0042), [v1 CHAPTER XXVI. The Story Club Is Formed P23](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0023), [v1 CHAPTER XXIX. An Epoch in Anne’s Life P11](../source/v01-c29.md#nw-v01-c29-p0011), +1 more</sub>

### [Fred Wright](../character/fred-wright.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/diana--fred-wright.md)
